opts.t: All over, or on the body too

nudges: Take five slow breaths, in for a count of four, out for a count of six.
Step outside for five minutes. Let your eyes land on something far away.
Roll your shoulders back three times, then let them drop.
Drink a full glass of water before you do anything else.
Unclench your jaw. Let your tongue rest away from the roof of your mouth.
Stand up and walk to the end of the room and back. That's it.
Notice the weather right now, really notice it, for thirty seconds.
Stretch your neck gently to one side, then the other.
Set your phone down for two minutes and just sit.
Shake your hands out like you're air-drying them. Let the tension go with it.
